agentTeams.description: Enable agent team support for adversarial review and parallel implementation

agentTeamModel.description: Model used by the Path A agent-team review agents in /flow:review (paired skeptic/verifier reviewers + challenge round). Resolved via the standard settings cascade (local > project > user > plugin default). Default is 'sonnet' because a paired-reviewer run dispatches ~20 agents — inheriting an Opus session would multiply Opus-rate tokens ~4x for marginal review value. Use 'inherit' to reproduce the pre-configuration behavior (agents run on the main session's model). Mirrors the configurable-model pattern of flow.goals.judge.model. Scoped to Path A only: Path B (single-session, default) agents always inherit the session model.

markerTrust.description: Trust filter for FLOW_REVIEW_CYCLE / FLOW_RESOLUTION_CYCLE markers honored by /flow:merge and /flow:status. SECURITY PIN: read from plugins/flow/settings.json ONLY (does NOT use the standard cascade) so a hostile fork PR cannot ship a permissive trust list via .claude/settings.flow.local.json after gh pr checkout. See references/gate-configuration.md for the threat model.

allowedAssociations.description: GitHub author_association values whose marker comments are honored. Lower-trust associations (CONTRIBUTOR, NONE) are excluded by default to prevent forgery from forks.

autoResolveTrivial.description: Automatically resolve trivial conflicts (non-overlapping changes) without asking

maxConflictFiles.description: Maximum conflicting files before suggesting alternative approach

specFirst.description: Spec-first enforcement settings. Requires acceptance criteria before starting work.

requireAcceptanceCriteria.description: When true, issues must have acceptance criteria before work starts. Without AC, autonomous verification cannot determine if the work is correct.

allowSpecFreeLabels.description: Issue labels that allow proceeding without acceptance criteria (e.g., docs-only changes)

verdict.description: Independent verdict judge settings. Evaluates acceptance criteria against collected evidence.

enabled.description: When true, dispatches an independent verdict-judge agent during VERIFY phase that evaluates acceptance criteria against evidence. The judge has no access to code-writing rationale.

requireAllPass.description: When true, ALL criteria must PASS for the completion gate. When false, NEEDS-HUMAN-REVIEW verdicts can be user-approved.

tddModeOptOut.description: When true with tddMode=suggest, suppresses warnings about missing tests.

enabled.description: Enable LSP code intelligence during workflow phases (EXPLORE, CODE, VERIFY)

timeout.description: Per-operation timeout in milliseconds for LSP requests

diagnosticsAsQuality.description: Consume LSP diagnostics as a quality signal during VERIFY phase (errors→P1, warnings→P2)

visualVerification.description: Visual verification settings for UI-facing changes

enabled.description: Enable visual verification for UI-facing changes

screenshotDir.description: Directory for verification screenshots (relative to project root)

requireVisualVerification.description: When true, visual verification cannot be silently skipped for UI changes. SKIP results require user confirmation before the completion gate passes.

reviewCycleLimit.description: Maximum review-and-address cycles between code-reviewer and code-author roles. Defaults to 10 because the ceiling is a safety net against true infinite loops, not a planned stop point — LLM operators iterate cheaply. See skills/llm-operator-principles/SKILL.md.

fixForwardMaxIterations.description: Maximum fix-forward iterations on self-review or holdout-validation findings. Defaults to 10 because the ceiling is a safety net, not a budget — convergence means zero findings, not exhausted budget. See skills/llm-operator-principles/SKILL.md.

autonomous.description: When true, the agent does NOT use AskUserQuestion for decisions the agent can resolve under the llm-operator-principles skill. AskUserQuestion is reserved for Tier 3 confirmations (merge, release) and true product/architecture decisions. Recommended for sole-maintainer repositories. See skills/llm-operator-principles/SKILL.md.

minimalScope.description: When true, restores the original deferral behavior for cosmetic P3 in untouched files only: the 'Create a follow-up issue?' AskUserQuestion is re-enabled, and Boy Scout expansion is softened. All other principles still apply (P1/P2 fix in-PR, no calendar estimates, fix-forward unbounded). Use when the user has deliberately constrained scope. See skills/llm-operator-principles/SKILL.md.

flow.description: Flow v3 runtime layer — goals, workflows, triggers. v3.0 wires goals into hooks + commands. See plugins/flow/references/flow-goals.md and references/stop-hook-goal-enforcement.md.

enabled.description: Master switch for the .flow/ runtime layer. Setting to false disables FlowGoal, FlowWorkflow, FlowTrigger, and FlowRun writes; existing files remain readable but no new ones are produced.

stateDir.description: Project-local directory for runtime state (relative to repo root). Changing this is rare — most teams should keep the default to maintain compatibility with the gitignore policy.

runRetentionDays.description: How many days of FlowRun records to keep under .flow/runs/ before a future cleanup helper prunes them. v3.0 reads this for documentation; a future minor release adds the prune script.

enabled.description: Master switch for the FlowGoal feature. When false, /flow:goal is disabled and the Stop hook fast-paths to approve.

goalCreation.description: Controls /flow:start FlowGoal auto-creation. 'auto' (default): create a goal iff the Spec Validation Gate passed with >=1 acceptance criterion carrying a verification_command (labels do not veto); spec-free issues yielding zero verifiable ACs are skipped silently. 'always': create unconditionally (a degenerate goal is allowed but flagged in the compact summary). 'off': never auto-create; manual /flow:goal create still works. Distinct from goals.enabled:false, which disables the whole feature. There is no consent prompt — invisible-auto is the default.

requireGoalForStart.description: DEPRECATED — superseded by goalCreation. Still accepted for backward compatibility via a read-only migration: true maps to goalCreation 'always', false maps to 'off'. Absence maps to 'auto'. Set goalCreation directly in new configs.

stopHookEnforcement.description: Stop hook posture: 'warn' (passive, no LLM, emits warning when active goal lacks evidence) | 'block' (same check, injects warning as next-turn prompt) | 'evaluator-loop' (active Haiku judge per turn, ~$0.001/eval, opt-in). See references/stop-hook-goal-enforcement.md.

failAfterStuckTurns.description: In evaluator-loop mode, the Stop hook transitions the goal to 'failed' if the pass-set hash is unchanged for this many consecutive turns. Prevents infinite churn on goals that can't make forward progress.

executeVerificationCommands.description: Security gate: when false (default), the Stop hook does NOT execute goal verification_command strings — ACs are reported as 'incomplete_acs' with reason 'not_executed'. When true, the hook runs each AC's verification_command via `bash -c` with a 30s timeout. Default-deny: a hostile repo's goal YAML cannot auto-execute commands on first turn after checkout.

model.description: Claude model used by the evaluator-loop judge subprocess. Haiku is the cost-effective default (~$0.001/eval); sonnet/opus available for harder rubrics.

timeoutSeconds.description: Hard timeout on the judge subprocess. If exceeded, the hook approves the stop with a 'judge timed out' notice rather than blocking indefinitely.

enabled.description: Master switch for the FlowWorkflow feature. v3.0 ships this opt-in (default false); projects flip to true once they want machine-readable workflow definitions in /flow:workflow.
Master switch for the FlowTrigger feature. v3.0 ships this opt-in (default false); projects flip to true once they want /flow:trigger and /flow:watch enabled.

allowedTypes.description: Trigger types allowed in this project. v3.0 supports manual/hook/loop_prompt; github_actions/local_cron/local_daemon are deferred to v3.1+.

allowAutonomousMerge.description: Non-negotiable in v3.0 — Tier 3 actions (merge, release) require explicit AskUserQuestion confirmation; no trigger can grant merge autonomy.

allowTriggerCreationFromTriggeredRun.description: Recursion policy: by default, runs initiated by a trigger may NOT create new triggers. Prevents trigger-creates-trigger loops.

defaultConcurrency.description: Default concurrency policy when a trigger fires while a prior run is in flight.

maxActiveTriggers.description: Maximum number of triggers in active status. Zero disables triggers entirely (same as triggers.enabled=false but composable).
